Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np
def solve2(g):
    g=np.array(g); out=g.copy()
    vals,cnt=np.unique(g,return_counts=True); bg=vals[np.argmax(cnt)]
    shape=vals[cnt.argmin()] if len(vals)>1 else bg
    # shape color = non-bg color
    shape=[v for v in vals if v!=bg]
    if not shape: return out
    sc=shape[0]
    rs,cs=np.where(g==sc)

    return out

def solve4(g):
    g=np.array(g); out=g.copy()
    vals,cnt=np.unique(g,return_counts=True)
    bg=vals[np.argmax(cnt)]; sc=[v for v in vals if v!=bg][0]
    rs,cs=np.where(g==sc)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=rs.min(),rs.max(),cs.min(),cs.max()
    for i in range(g.shape[0]):
        for j in range(g.shape[1]):
            if ((i in (r0,r1) and c0<=j<=c1) or (j in (c0,c1) and r0<=i<=r1)) and g[i,j]==bg:
                out[i,j]=2
    return out

def solve6(g, maxgap=2):
    g=np.array(g); out=g.copy()
    vals,cnt=np.unique(g,return_counts=True)
    bg=vals[np.argmax(cnt)]; sc=[v for v in vals if v!=bg][0]
    m=(g==sc)
    rs,cs=np.where(m); r0,r1,c0,c1=rs.min(),rs.max(),cs.min(),cs.max()
    R,C=g.shape
    def border(i,j): return (i in (r0,r1) and c0<=j<=c1) or (j in (c0,c1) and r0<=i<=r1)
    for i in range(R):
        for j in range(C):
            if g[i,j]!=bg: continue
            if border(i,j): out[i,j]=2; continue
            rowm=np.where(m[i])[0]; colm=np.where(m[:,j])[0]
            L=[k for k in rowm if k<j]; Rt=[k for k in rowm if k>j]
            U=[k for k in colm if k<i]; D=[k for k in colm if k>i]
            if L and Rt and min(Rt)-max(L)-1<=maxgap: out[i,j]=2
            elif U and D and min(D)-max(U)-1<=maxgap: out[i,j]=2
    return out

def solve7(g):
    g=np.array(g); out=g.copy()
    vals,cnt=np.unique(g,return_counts=True)
    bg=vals[np.argmax(cnt)]; sc=[v for v in vals if v!=bg][0]
    m=(g==sc)
    rs,cs=np.where(m); r0,r1,c0,c1=rs.min(),rs.max(),cs.min(),cs.max()
    R,C=g.shape
    def border(i,j): return (i in (r0,r1) and c0<=j<=c1) or (j in (c0,c1) and r0<=i<=r1)
    def runlen_row(i,j):  # length of mark run containing (i,j) horizontally
        a=j
        while a-1>=0 and m[i,a-1]: a-=1
        b=j
        while b+1<C and m[i,b+1]: b+=1
        return b-a+1
    def runlen_col(i,j):
        a=i
        while a-1>=0 and m[a-1,j]: a-=1
        b=i
        while b+1<R and m[b+1,j]: b+=1
        return b-a+1
    for i in range(R):
        for j in range(C):
            if g[i,j]!=bg: continue
            if border(i,j): out[i,j]=2; continue
            rowm=np.where(m[i])[0]; colm=np.where(m[:,j])[0]
            L=[k for k in rowm if k<j]; Rt=[k for k in rowm if k>j]
            if L and Rt:
                a,b=max(L),min(Rt)
                if b-a-1<=2 and runlen_row(i,a)>=2 and runlen_row(i,b)>=2: out[i,j]=2; continue
            U=[k for k in colm if k<i]; D=[k for k in colm if k>i]
            if U and D:
                a,b=max(U),min(D)
                if b-a-1<=2 and runlen_col(a,j)>=2 and runlen_col(b,j)>=2: out[i,j]=2
    return out

def solve_final(gi):
    gi=np.array(gi); go=gi.copy()
    vals,cnt=np.unique(gi,return_counts=True); bg=vals[np.argmax(cnt)]; mk=[v for v in vals if v!=bg][0]
    marks=(gi==mk); rs,cs=np.where(marks)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=rs.min(),rs.max(),cs.min(),cs.max()
    def onborder(i,j): return i in (r0,r1) or j in (c0,c1)
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            if onborder(i,j) and gi[i,j]==bg: go[i,j]=2
    qual=[]
    R,C=gi.shape
    for orient in ('row','col'):
        nR = R if orient=='row' else C
        for L in range(nR):
            if orient=='row': idx=[j for j in range(c0,c1+1) if gi[L,j]==mk]
            else: idx=[i for i in range(r0,r1+1) if gi[i,L]==mk]
            if len(idx)<3: continue
            gaps=[list(range(a+1,b)) for a,b in zip(idx,idx[1:]) if b-a>1]
            if gaps and len(gaps)<=2 and all(len(g)==1 for g in gaps) \
               and not any(onborder(*((L,t) if orient=='row' else (t,L))) for g in gaps for t in g):
                qual.append((orient,L))
                for g in gaps:
                    for t in g:
                        r_,c_ = (L,t) if orient=='row' else (t,L)
                        if gi[r_,c_]==bg: go[r_,c_]=2
    for (orient,L) in qual:
        seq=list(range(c0,c1+1)) if orient=='row' else list(range(r0,r1+1))
        for t in range(1,len(seq)-1):
            r_,c_ = (L,seq[t]) if orient=='row' else (seq[t],L)
            if gi[r_,c_]!=bg or go[r_,c_]==2: continue
            pr,pc = (L,seq[t-1]) if orient=='row' else (seq[t-1],L)
            nr,nc = (L,seq[t+1]) if orient=='row' else (seq[t+1],L)
            if (go[pr,pc]==2 and gi[nr,nc]==mk) or (gi[pr,pc]==mk and go[nr,nc]==2):
                go[r_,c_]=2
    return go
